comment:
What are you? Stupid? This is The Perfect Band, remember?
	Your not supposed to change it, because any change would make it less than perfect.
	Global honcho G Jerome Vonderbaldt is rightly upset and changes it back to the Perfect set up.
	You better think about what you're doing.

You were supposed to keep this band together.\n\tNot that the musicians really matter  they will never be perfect  but Global has decided it cannot trust you any longer.\n\tGlobal will find somebody else to manage The Perfect Band.
Global won't let you record anything other than The Perfect song.\n\tYou didn't really think you'd get away with that, did you?
Good news! While you were recording, Global's scientists developed The Perfect Style  clothes and shoes to suit The Perfect Band.\n\tNow The Perfect Band is one step closer to perfection.

The best thing since fire!" writes Zer0 Magazine reporter Andy Fairlane in his ecstatic review of The Perfect Band's concert.\n\t"These stars shine brighter than the lights of Colosseum," and "This is the definite band, or my name ain't Andy Fairlane."\n\tThe Perfect Band makes him forget all other bands in the history of rock

The Perfect Band have broken the sales record for the first week. In fact, sales the first week were three times higher than the previous record.\n\tIt seems that all types of people are buying <¤Calbum.name>.
Zer0 Magazine has heard about the new Rock 'n' Roll sensation The Perfect Band.\n\tThey are desperate to get an interview, before everyone else beats them to it.

Despite refusing an interview, The Perfect Band are on the front page of the new Zer0 Magazine issue.\n\tThey print sixteen pages about the band, including creative reconstruction of the bands history, poetic reference to an old racing movie and a heartfelt tribute to their integrity (as they won't do interviews).\n\tThe editor promises his readers to never print a line about another band again. From now on Zer0 Magazine is going to be completely about The Perfect Band.

The Zer0 interview treats The Perfect Band's every word like that of an oracle.\n\tWhen Alba says he dreams of being able to live off of his music, the reporter interprets it as a message to the world that we should all work less and play more music to make this planet a better place.
Word of TPB's grandeur has reached the classic concert venue Avenue. They want the band to do a gig as soon as possible.\n\tThey will gladly pay $10.000 for the honour of hosting TPB.

The critics all agree that The Perfect Band gave the perfect concert last night.\n\tCity News prints that TPB are bound to bring world peace, and a Radio FM reports that TPB's music reaches "biblical proportions."

It is unheard of that Avenue would invite a band to play  it's always been the other way around.\n\tIn contrast it is unheard of that a band would even turn down such an offer!\n\tCity News admires your courage and says that only a talented band like The Perfect Band could get away with that.

Lola Hertz of Radio FM humbly asks if her station could have the honour of airing The Perfect Band's next concert.\n\tIt will be a prime time show and she would happily pay $12,000, which is this year's music budget.

They've been building up towards this moment for a week:\n\tThere is a countdown presentation for The Perfect Song every fifteen minutes, and every thirty minutes there's a Perfect Band competition. Every hour Lola Hertz presents a piece of Perfect Band-trivia.\n\tRadio FM air a unique live broadcast of The Perfect Band's concert for the first time. The performance will be aired several hundred times more before the end of this month.

The decline to broadcast didn't stop Radio FM from contributing to the hype.\n\tInstead of the concert, they air a panel debate with the country's finest musical experts.\n\tUnlike other such shows, the participants all agree on The Perfect Band's genius and try to outdo each other in praising them.
Luxury car maker Ferretti wants to use The Perfect Song in a commercial for TPB inspired new sports model, "The Perfect Car."\n\tThey will pay $30.000 for the license.

World-famous fashion designer Cornelius Pablo thinks that The Perfect Band are just so frighteningly right.\n\tHe wants them to present his new haute couture collection on the catwalk in Paris next month.\n\tHe will pay $20.000.

The band informs you they have accepted an offer from Global Films to appear in 18th century costume drama feature entitled The Baroness's Kiss. The contract has already been signed.\n\tGlobal Films will pay $50.000 for their participation.

TV24 show a one-hour "behind-the-scenes" documentary about the making of The Baroness's Kiss.\n\tMost of the program focuses on The Perfect Band's participation in the movie and their fantastic talent as actors.

The motion picture The Baroness's Kiss, featuring The Perfect Band, opens on thousands of silver screens around the globe.\n\tRecord box office sales are broken including the biggest gross earnings opening night, most tickets sold, biggest global earnings, best overall reviews, best audience satisfaction and so on.\n\tGlobal Films pay you a $100.000 bonus.

The Perfect Band gives a free "concert of love" at the Taj Mahal in India.
	Thousands of fans travel from all over the globe and more than five thousand reporters cover the event.
	Of course it is an outstanding success in the name of love (what did you expect?). The Perfect Band appears in specially designed pink suits to celebrate the event.
	City News calls it "The beginning of a new religion."

The City News' Arts & Culture section posts a special edition on The Perfect Band from a postmodern point-of-view.\n\tAll the important intellectuals take the opportunity to elaborate on the transcendental theme that is central to The Perfect Band's work, and emphasize the vast impact they've had on redefining the public perception of their art by juxtaposing the imperatives of the artist and the audience.
The Perfect Band is invited to play at the Olympic Games opening ceremonies next week. The show will be broadcast live via satellite all over the globe.

The Olympic opening ceremonies are a dull event and even the participants themselves seem to be waiting only for the TPB gig.\n\tAt last the band plays while peace pigeons fly over the stadium, fireworks light the sky and twenty thousand school children all dressed in white enter the stadium, each carrying a bunch of white roses which they lay before the stage.
The British court dub The Perfect Band as knights. Now they may call themselves Sir Perfect Band, if they wish.\n\tYou weren't knighted.

The band inform you that they plan to do a gig at the foot of the Cheops Pyramid in Giza, Egypt, since the Taj Mahal concert of love was such a big success.\n\tEverything's already been decided by Global and the gig is only days away.

Like you would expect, the Pyramid show is an outstanding success and the critics grow lyrical trying to describe the feeling of The Perfect Song in the cool desert night in such a special setting.\n\tThe band now is discussing a gig atop the Great Wall of China  the world's longest concert!
The Perfect Song sets a new sales record. It has now sold more copies than all the other records in the world put together.
TV24 offer The Perfect Band its own weekly TV-show: Friday night prime-time with satellite distribution all over the world.
The Perfect Band has its own worldwide television show. 95% of the world's population watched the pilot and all other TV stations cancelled their broadcast for the duration of the program.

The cabinet have appointed Billy "Alba" Watt their new youth minister.\n\tHis strong political commitment and his integrity to turn down the offer for his own TV-show are the reasons given for the appointment.\n\tBilly is overjoyed and plans to change the establishment from the inside-out.
The Global Corporation opens a theme park, Perfect-World, entirely dedicated to The Perfect Band. It's an instant success.

A civil war has broken out in a third world country and in spite of the United Nations negotiation efforts, there is no peace in sight.\n\tNow the secretary general turns to The Perfect Band for assistance.\n\tIf they do a concert in the country, maybe there can finally be peace.

The peace concert had an immediate beneficial effect.\n\tHalfway throughout the gig, the armed forces agreed on a cease fire and the peace treaty will be signed within a few days.\n\tThe UN enter the Right to Perfect Music into the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, so that no human being shall want for The Perfect Song.
The Nobel Committee have instituted a new Nobel Prize for Music.

The Perfect Band declare their intention to do the first concert ever in outer space.\n\tThe Global Space Division has been working on it for a while, and soon they will be ready to send your band into orbit.
The Perfect Band do the first ever concert in outer space.\n\tPlaying in an orbiting capsule, their music reaches every corner of the globe.
Global kingpin G. Jerome Vonderbaldt is steaming mad at you for trying to change TPB's name.\n\tHe immediately changes it back.
You don't think that The Perfect Band should play The Perfect Song?\n\tFine. It should, however, come as no surprise that Global has a different opinion.

Hey! The Perfect Band is Global Records' creature, so don't you try anything.\n\tYou're a nobody! You're just the errand boy for this job. You are more replaceable than any of the band members.\n\tSorry, but you're out.
Let's settle this once and for all: YOU'RE NOT SUPPOSED TO CHANGE THE PERFECT BAND!
Okay, start over and next time try to record The Perfect Song.
Try again and stay with Global.

The Global boss is furious that you won't let The Perfect Band appear on the cover of The Perfect Song in their Perfect Stage Costumes.\n\tHe will let this mistake slide, but you should be warned of such negligence.
Your funds are limited so spend them carefully.
